submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb 0.33) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0178%. That is about 10× higher than its neighbours at index 0 (0.0018%) and index 8 (0.0012%). Higher Sb content gave much lower EQE (index 13: 0.0002%, index 21: about 0). XRD shows the same Pb-rich pyrochlore-like phase at indices 0 and 3, so the drop at index 0 is not caused by a phase change. The peak is probably a narrow optimum near Sb 0.30–0.36.

rejected.reason: Same phase as index 3 but EQE was 10x lower (0.0018%)
